data.question: What exactly do I get?
data.answer: **Private community access**, a comprehensive Notion guide covering **13 topic areas**, all the bonuses (**€340+** worth including [Obsidian Starter Kit](/products/obsidian-starter-kit), courses, workshops), and **lifetime access** to everything I add in the future.

data.question: Is this a one-time payment?
data.answer: Yes. Pay **€149.99 once** and you own it forever. **No subscriptions**, no recurring fees. All future updates included.

data.question: How is this different from your other products?
data.answer: This is **everything in one place**. The [Obsidian Starter Kit](/products/obsidian-starter-kit) focuses on `Obsidian` specifically. [Knowledge Management for Beginners](/products/knowledge-management-for-beginners) teaches PKM theory. The Knowledge Worker Kit covers all of it: career, learning, projects, tasks, focus, personal development, and more. Plus you get **community access** and all the bonuses.

data.question: Do I need to use Obsidian?
data.answer: No. The guide covers universal principles that work with any tools. The Obsidian bonuses are included if you want them, but the core systems are tool-agnostic.

data.question: How much time does this take to implement?
data.answer: That's up to you. The guide is modular. Focus on what's useful right now. Each section stands on its own, so you can implement at whatever pace works for your life.

data.question: Is the community active?
data.answer: The community is growing. As more members join, activity increases. You'll have direct access to me and fellow knowledge workers who are figuring this out together.

data.question: Will this really help me with AI?
data.answer: Yes. The kit covers both sides: developing skills that AI can't replicate (creativity, critical thinking, human insight) and learning how to use AI tools as part of your workflow.

data.question: Can I get a refund?
data.answer: Check Gumroad's refund policy for digital products. They typically have refund windows.

data.question: Is this included in any other products?
data.answer: Yes. It's included free with [Knowii Community](/products/knowii-community) paid subscriptions. Also part of the [Everything Knowledge Bundle](/products/everything-knowledge-bundle).

data.question: What if the content becomes outdated?
data.answer: It won't. This is an evergreen project that I continuously update. Lifetime access means you always get the latest version.
